title: M7: pixelelated 0.0.1
description:
## Current priority — M7.P5 combined image built; VM qualification in progress

The owner has approved engineering firmware transfers and one reboot each for the RG35XX SP, RG SP and Retroid Pocket Nova, plus the named preparation and screenshot checks. #519's controlled RG35XX SP alignment is ACCEPTED before transfer: exact state-bound receipt, all163 protected files/recovery/credentials preserved, stale experimental records archived and automatic cloud sync disabled. Completed alignment, builds, audits and original-image qualification remain accepted; the next changed image receives its own qualification.

All three approved transfers, single reboots, installed-artifact checks, preservation comparisons and reviewed compositor frames are COMPLETE. RG35XX SP accepted15:24UTC, RG SP15:54UTC, Nova16:01UTC, followed by final preservation/frame review. Every original stage/reboot result channel is0 and actual owners exited. Both additional devices have been handed back for normal use. Those deployment/build/audit jobs have ended. The #529 VM investigation is complete; its source delta and next-candidate qualification are recorded below. Nova startup observations are retained under #344: one recovered frontend retry also occurs on the prior build; the early SMMU burst is not assigned a cause or frequency. No physical gameplay/audio claim.

### Current work in order

**Completed device work:** #519 alignment and the authorized RG35XX SP, RG SP and Nova transfers/reboots/readbacks are complete. Devices are in owner use; automatic startup/game-exit sync remains off. No new physical action is authorized by this planning update.
